latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Image to Video Hunyuan skill.
- Turn a single product photo or landscape image into 1080p animated video clips in 1-3 minutes.
- Simple workflow: upload an image, describe the animation you want, and download the result.
- Supports key actions via chat prompts: export, upload, check credits, or manage timeline state.
- Built-in cloud rendering pipeline—no local export required.
- Free trial with 100 credits; supports common video and image formats (mp4, mov, avi, jpg, png, etc).
